question: My game will not launch on Proton, what should I check?
reply: Alright, listen up, you got a problem with your game won't start on Proton? Don't panic, this ain't rocket science, but you gotta follow the script. First thing, you gotta check ProtonDB. That's where the community folks tell you if there's some known fix for that specific game. Then, if that ain't it, you gotta dig into the logs. You run that command, PROTON_LOG=1 %command%, and that spits out a file. That file is the secret sauce; it tells you exactly where the game is tripping up. If you're on a Windows setup, remember, Proton ain't the deal there; you gotta look at your native DirectX or Vulkan drivers. Keep it simple, check the DB, check the logs, and you'll be sorted.

So for a troubleshooting turn the block only arrives with the finished snapshot fetched after completion; the live path that shows a game note before the first word does not carry tips. Row 06 therefore holds for game notes and fails for tips. Sent back to the block's lane with this file.
The launch option in the reply, PROTON_LOG=1 %command%, matches the tip exactly, which is the fact the block was meant to guarantee; here the model happened to keep it.

The tip's header names the tip's topic word, 'proton', as the note name, since tips carry no title; the drawing had left the name out for tips. Either is honest; the topic word reads a little odd. Worth a call when the maintainer sees it.
